brief: Best opportunity: cactus-compute/needle (14MB AI model for edge devices)
Other standouts: volcengine/OpenViking (AI agents), watermarks-remover (AI watermark removal)
AI-powered short video generator from keywords
AI gateway for developers with 340+ providers and 1200+ models

items.name: cactus-compute/needle
items.one_liner: 14MB AI model for edge devices
items.pain_point: Enables AI on tiny devices for real-time processing and privacy
app_ideas: Privacy-focused voice assistant for wearables
Smart home device with on-device AI for energy efficiency
Robotics control system with real-time decision making
items.monetization: B2B API wrapper for enterprise edge AI solutions
items.why_now: Growing demand for edge AI and increasing adoption of AI in IoT

items.name: volcengine/OpenViking
items.one_liner: Persistent memory and knowledge layer for AI agents
items.pain_point: AI agents lose context between sessions and can't access private data. Developers building agentic apps waste weeks building custom memory systems when they should be shipping features.
app_ideas: Embeddable agent memory SDK - add persistent context to any AI agent in <50 lines of code
Agent hosting platform with built-in memory - deploy agents that remember users, learned skills, and conversation history across sessions
No-code agent builder with pre-configured knowledge bases - visual tool for non-engineers to create agents grounded in their own documents
items.monetization: Freemium developer API (free tier for 1000 memory ops/month) + usage-based pricing at scale + enterprise tier with private knowledge clusters
items.why_now: AI agents are exploding (Cursor, Manus, Operator) but memory/knowledge infrastructure is fragmented - OpenViking's 9.28% weekly growth signals the market is ready for consolidation

items.why_now: Increasing demand for API integration and developer tools
